description: A script for copying and processing JS vendor dependencies from node_modules to the assets/vendor directory, including updating library versions in a YAML file and handling specific file processing callbacks.

methods.name: updateLibraryVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of a library in the core.libraries.yml file based on the package.json version.

methods.name: normalizeFile
methods.description: Normalizes file entries to an object with 'from' and 'to' properties.
